train.reason: no verified cross-venue history is frozen, so no train window is opened

held_out.reason: no verified cross-venue history is frozen, so no held-out window is opened

parameters.selection: training-only; the grid is empty until a train window and its booked results exist

sample_rules.independent_pair: one completed round trip whose entry slot is not inside another open pair

verdict_rules.pass: held-out booked net after fees and funding is positive, drawdown is within the frozen bound, both baselines are beaten, sample and coverage floors pass, and every economic comparison is eligible
verdict_rules.fail: the evidence floors pass and the pass rule is false
verdict_rules.inconclusive: any required evidence, sample floor, coverage floor, or unresolved obligation is missing

evidence_requirements: real venue capability and account evidence
historical cross-venue depth, not a snapshot
at least 30 independent completed pairs on the held-out window
mechanical_classification: a synthetic fixture run is a mechanical diagnostic: study scored is false, promotion_eligible is false, and the verdict is inconclusive

costs.source: member cost_policy on the admitted pair contract
costs.missing: no frozen real fee schedule is attached to this study

funding.source: recording manifest or frozen funding document
funding.oracle: a research receipt price is not a historical venue oracle price

data_coverage.missing: no OKX sealed recording and no continuous cross-venue depth are frozen

costs.missing: no frozen real fee schedule is attached to this study

latency.missing: latency cases are declared and not run; no depth history is frozen

failure_cases.missing: venue failure cases are declared and not run; no depth history is frozen

booked_net.missing: no booked trades exist for the committed study

funding_policy.missing: no recording manifest or frozen funding document is attached

oracle_visibility.source: a standalone research oracle price is visible at receipt; sealed playback publishes it at the recorded consumption step; neither is a historical venue oracle price
